text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian can't focus on her training. 
Not being able to face Symboli Rudolf at 
the summer training camp still lingers in 
her mind.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer requested a mock race with 
Symboli Rudolf, making the showdown a 
reality.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The result—Narita Brian lost by a neck.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, she saw an even greater gap in 
strength. Was her defeat due to 
overconfidence in herself? She and her 
Trainer accept this experience and turn it 
into fuel to grow stronger.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, Narita Brian declared 
war on Symboli Rudolf. The shocking rumor 
swept across the entire academy—
